schemaProof.originalFallback: Unknown version/expanded epoch, unexpected compiled properties shape or unsupported config retains original native whole-root validation.
schemaProof.canonical: Full original canonical validation first; no serialization/canonical representation substitution.
schemaProof.errors: Same fixed INVALID_CONTRACT422 on any root or child violation; detailed diagnostics not returned. Missing schema behavior unchanged.
schemaProof.immutability: Schema strategy contains only immutable compiled metadata; no session data, successful-validation cache, runtime documents or authority reuse.
